# The Pragmatic Engineer

> > A newsletter by Gergely Orosz covering engineering management, developer productivity, and tech industry insights from Big Tech companies like Uber, Google, Meta, and OpenAI.

The Pragmatic Engineer is a leading tech newsletter providing in-depth analysis of engineering practices, startup culture, and industry trends. It features exclusive scoops, technical deep-dives, and practical guidance for software engineers and engineering leaders working at scale.

## Key Topics

- Engineering Management
- Developer Productivity
- Big Tech (Uber, Google, Meta, Amazon, Apple)
- AI/LLM Development and Evaluation
- Startup Culture and Funding
- Developer Tools (GitHub, Stacked Diffs)
- Tech Industry News (The Pulse series)
- Cloud Migration and Infrastructure
- Platform Engineering
- Salary Transparency
- Distributed Systems
- OpenAI and Anthropic
- Mobile Development (iOS, Android)
- Engineering Career Growth

## Engineering Practices & Developer Productivity

- [Measuring developer productivity? A response to McKinsey, Part 2](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/measuring-developer-productivity-part-2): Kent Beck & Gergely critique McKinsey's developer productivity methodology
- [Stacked Diffs (and why you should know about them)](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/stacked-diffs): Meta & Google's stacked diffs workflow for efficient small PRs
- [How to debug large, distributed systems: Antithesis](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/antithesis): Antithesis multiverse debugger for large-scale distributed systems
- [A pragmatic guide to LLM evals for devs](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/evals): Systematic engineering guide to LLM evaluation methods for AI engineers
- [Microsoft is dogfooding AI dev tools' future](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/microsoft-ai-dev-tools): Microsoft Build conference insights on Copilot dogfooding and AI agents

## Engineering Leadership & Organization

- [Inside Shopify's Leveling Split: Exclusive](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/inside-shopifys-leveling-split): Shopify's engineering level revamp and mastery framework deep dive
- ["Wartime" vs "Peacetime" at Tech Companies](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/wartime-vs-peacetime): Operating modes at tech companies and how to thrive in each phase
- [Platform Teams with Ganesh Srinivasan - by Gergely Orosz](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/platforms-with-ganesh-srinivasan): Platform team strategy, timing, funding with Confluent's Ganesh Srinivasan
- [What do GenZ software engineers really think?](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/genz-part-2): GenZ engineer survey on workplace values and generational differences

## Big Tech & Infrastructure Case Studies

- [Inside Uber's move to the Cloud: Part 2 - by Gergely Orosz](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/inside-ubers-move-to-the-cloud-part): Uber's data center challenges and Google Cloud migration strategy
- [Startups on hard mode: Oxide. Part 1: Hardware](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/oxide): Oxide Computer's hardware-software cloud computer startup deep dive

## Tech Industry News (The Pulse)

- [The Pulse #162: Even fewer middle managers and more flexible teams?](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-pulse-162-even-fewer-middle-managers): Org structure trends, Anthropic vs Codex policies, AI development news
- [The Pulse #145: More clarity on the tech jobs market](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-pulse-145-more-clarity-on-the): Tech hiring trends, Google lawsuit, OpenAI acquisitions, LLM risks
- [The Pulse #139: Section 174 is reversed! Or is it?](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-pulse-139): Section 174 tax regulation reversal, Meta poaching OpenAI researchers
- [The Pulse #119: Are LLMs making StackOverflow irrelevant?](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-pulse-119): LLM impact on StackOverflow, Apple charity scam, AI model improvements
- [The Pulse #115: LLM improvements slowing down?](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-pulse-115): LLM scaling limits, ChatGPT search, AWS costs, open source security
- [The Pulse #57: Google Shutting down Firebase Dynamic Links](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-pulse-57-google-shutting-down): Google Firebase shutdown, Wise salaries, Hopin sale, Uber profits news

## Startup Insights & Exclusives

- [The Scoop: Inside Fast's Rapid Collapse - by Gergely Orosz](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-scoop-fast): Exclusive details on Fast startup shutdown and lessons for engineers
